old: It also reported that Meta's indirect emissions were more than 105% above their 2021 level, against a supporting target to keep them from exceeding that baseline by 2030.[^3]
new: It also reported that Meta's indirect emissions were more than 105% above their 2021 level, though Meta's report sets the supporting Scope 3 baseline deadline at the end of 2031, not 2030.[^2][^3]
why: Trellis stated 2030 for the supporting Scope 3 baseline target, but Page 8 of Meta's 2026 Sustainability Report sets the deadline at the end of 2031.

support.quote: Not exceed our 2021 baseline Scope 3 emissions by the end of 2031.
